scheme_name: Assistance to Voluntary Organizations Working for Welfare of OBCs
other_conditions: Organization must be registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 or any relevant State/UT act or public trust.
Organization must have an appropriate administrative structure and a managing/executive committee.
Organization must be democratically governed without external control.
Organization must have been registered for at least three years (waivable in exceptional cases).
Organization must maintain a bank account in its own name for at least three years.
Organization must not be run for profit by any individual or body of individuals.
Organization should have at least two years of experience in the relevant field.
Projects should be located in backward districts identified by the Planning Commission.
Beneficiary must belong to the Central or state/UT OBC list.
Beneficiary's annual family income should not exceed ₹1,00,000.
benefits_summary: Provides financial support of up to 90% of approved project costs for skill‑development initiatives benefiting OBC beneficiaries.
documents_required: Mandatory documents as per the Ministry's requirements
